note: Generated from services/agent model_stats.py; the web app's model.test.ts and services/agent tests/test_model_stats.py both check these numbers (cases: history stats and flags; scenario_cases: which assumptions each scenario uses; default_cases: the run-rate defaults a new model starts from, on real TTM rows of four shapes).

cases.name: gaps, a negative year, a base year without operating income

scenario_cases.name: a case with other years is ignored
malformed entries are dropped, booleans aren't numbers

default_cases.name: hyper-growth: NVIDIA, TTM to FY2027 Q2
accelerating: Vertiv, TTM to FY2026 Q3
steady: Deckers, TTM to FY2027 Q2 (5-yr CAGR well above the run rate)
shrinking: Intel, 5-yr CAGR below zero (the long run is held at 0%)
synthetic: run rate falling 20%, no TTM margin
